title: Premium Multi-Density Cheek Pads
features: Multi-density foam construction for superior comfort and impact absorption
Universal fit compatible with most full-face motorcycle helmets
Easy snap-in replacement design for quick installation
description:
Designed to optimize interior helmet ergonomics and temperature regulation, the Premium Multi-Density Cheek Pads from Universal Moto keeps riders dry, focused, and comfortable across grueling saddle stints. Built with Hydrophilic Moisture-Wicking Core with Fast-Evaporating Air-Mesh Outer, it boasts an installation rating of 1.0 / 10 (Direct snap-tab alignment into EPS cheek-pad / liner channels).

Engineered for all-season comfort, the Premium Multi-Density Cheek Pads from Universal Moto delivers exceptional moisture management and skin comfort, shielding riders from biting wind-chill and summer humidity.
